title: Protests and clashes in Kangpokpi over deaths of two men
seoTitle: Kangpokpi protests over deaths of two men

tea.why: Protesters are angered by the recovery of the bodies of two missing men who had been abducted in the district.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand the removal of a deputy chief minister from the state cabinet and fulfillment of five demands by CoTU.
tea.changed: Nov 2: Additional security forces were deployed to Kangpokpi as tension remained high following clashes.

summary: Tensions escalated in Manipur's Kangpokpi district after the bodies of two missing young men were discovered during a joint search operation. The discovery triggered protests, street blockades with burning tires and logs, and clashes between demonstrators and security forces. Protesters attempted to storm the Superintendent of Police's office after the bodies were brought to the district hospital. Security personnel responded by firing tear gas shells, baton-charging crowds, and firing live rounds into the air, while demonstrators retaliated with stones and slingshots. The Committee on Tribal Unity (CoTU) refused to accept the mortal remains of the deceased and announced a total district shutdown along with five demands, including the removal of Deputy Chief Minister Losii Dikho from the state cabinet.
demands: Remove Deputy Chief Minister Losii Dikho from the state cabinet
Fulfill CoTU's five demands before accepting the bodies
response: Police fired tear gas shells, baton-charged protesters, and fired rounds into the air to disperse the crowds, according to officials. Additional security forces were deployed to the district.

injuries.text: At least three protesters were injured in the confrontation, officials said.
